examples.content:
# Code Style

- Use spaces for indentation (2 spaces)
- Prefer functional components in React
- Use TypeScript strict mode

# Project Conventions

## Naming

- Components: PascalCase
- Functions: camelCase
- Constants: UPPER_SNAKE_CASE
